topics.title: Saudi pipeline attack raises oil worries
topics.summary: Iraq said drone attacks on a key Saudi oil pipeline originated from its territory, prompting an investigation and renewed concern about regional shipping and energy prices.
topics.discussionPrompt: If one faraway pipeline suddenly changes everyone’s budget, who in the studio becomes the emergency energy expert?

topics.title: BRICS summit spotlights global tensions
topics.summary: BRICS leaders meeting in New Delhi raised concerns over conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine while pushing for a larger role for emerging economies in global decisions.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a huge summit promises a new world order, who wants details and who just wants the lunch menu?

topics.title: India and China try a reset
topics.summary: Narendra Modi and Xi Jinping met during the BRICS summit, signaling a cautious thaw after years of border tension and strategic rivalry between India and China.
topics.discussionPrompt: What does a believable reset look like when two people have a long history and neither wants to blink first?

topics.title: AI safety debate intensifies
topics.summary: Anthropic’s CEO called for slowing AI development so safety work can catch up, as new reports highlighted misuse risks involving weapons, spying, and cyber operations.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who in the studio thinks slowing down is responsible, and who hears that as somebody grabbing the brakes too hard?

topics.title: Trump comments stir Ireland debate
topics.summary: During a visit to Ireland, Donald Trump said Irish reunification would be fantastic, prompting political pushback and renewed attention to the Good Friday Agreement’s consent principle.
topics.discussionPrompt: When an outsider casually pokes a sensitive local issue, who changes the subject and who pulls up a chair?

topics.title: Ukraine drone lessons reach U.S. troops
topics.summary: Ukrainian personnel embedded with U.S. forces during drills in Germany to share battlefield drone tactics, highlighting how fast modern military training is changing.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the studio had to learn a whole new tool under pressure, who adapts fastest and who demands a manual?

topics.title: Wall Street rebounds after oil slips
topics.summary: U.S. stock indexes rose Friday as oil prices eased and inflation data matched expectations, though the major indexes still finished the week lower.
topics.discussionPrompt: After a rough week ends on a decent note, who celebrates early and who keeps refreshing the chart?

topics.title: Local news cuts hit McClatchy
topics.summary: McClatchy laid off more than 90 unionized journalists across 17 publications, sharpening worries about local reporting capacity and civic accountability.
topics.discussionPrompt: If the town paper suddenly shrinks, what stories would the studio miss first: sports, politics, food, or gossip?

topics.title: Hurricane Lowell batters Hawaii
topics.summary: The Guardian’s weather tracker reported widespread damage across parts of Hawaii’s western islands as Hurricane Lowell brought severe conditions to Niihau, Kauai, and Oahu.
topics.discussionPrompt: When bad weather becomes the whole day’s plot, who prepares perfectly and who improvises with snacks and tape?

topics.title: College football eyes Ohio State-Texas
topics.summary: A highly anticipated No. 1 Ohio State versus No. 4 Texas matchup leads the college football weekend, with playoff talk already hovering over the game.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who in the studio turns one big game into a full production, and who only shows up for the snacks?
